card.name: Comma in opioid-tolerance definition
card.fires_on: The comma right after "receiving" or "taking" in the opioid-tolerant patient definition, where a drug and dose list is expected to follow. It is weaker on the words just before that comma.

modes.label: Comma after receiving/taking
modes.description: The comma straight after "receiving" or "taking" in the definition of opioid-tolerant patients, just before "for one week or longer".
modes.example: Patients considered to be opioid tolerant are those who are receiving<<,>> for one week

modes.label: Words leading into the comma
modes.description: The word "who" or "taking" in the same definition, just before the comma.
modes.example: Patients considered opioid-tolerant are those<< taking>>, for one week or longer, at

card.plain: It marks the spot in the opioid-tolerance definition where the specific drug and dose amounts would normally be listed.
